# QUBE Markets × Apple 金秋臻耀礼遇 (Qube x Apple Autumn Gala Rewards)

> 活动落地页 / Campaign landing page for the QUBE Markets "金秋臻耀礼遇" (Autumn Gala Rewards) promotion, where eligible clients who meet net-deposit and traded-volume targets can claim Apple product rewards across six tiers.

## 活动概览 / Overview
- 主办方 / Operator: QUBE Markets (qubemarkets.com)
- 活动名称 / Promotion: Qube × Apple 金秋臻耀礼遇 — Autumn Gala Rewards
- 活动期间 / Period: 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-14 (MT4/MT5 server time, GMT+3, 00:00–23:59)
- 报名截止 / Registration deadline: 2026-10-14 23:59 server time. Clients who do not register are not eligible even if targets are met.
- 参与方式 / How to join: register on this page's online form, email support@qubemarkets.com with "promotion name + full name + trading account", or ask your account manager.

## 礼遇档位 / Reward tiers (net deposit USD / eligible lots / indicative reward value USD)
1. 3,000 / 20 lots / ~150 — Apple accessory bundle (MagSafe charger + AirTag)
2. 5,000 / 40 lots / ~350 — AirPods Pro 4
3. 10,000 / 80 lots / ~420 — Apple Watch Series 12 (aluminium, GPS)
4. 30,000 / 150 lots / ~850 — Apple Watch Ultra 4 (titanium)
5. 50,000 / 288 lots / ~1,400 — iPhone 18 Pro Max
6. 100,000 / 450 lots / ~2,400 — iPhone Ultra (foldable, 256GB)

Both the net-deposit and the eligible-lot target must be met for the same tier. Tiers cannot be stacked, split, or combined.

## 重要说明 / Key notes
- Reward values are indicative overseas USD estimates for tier matching only; they are not official Apple pricing.
- Product images are illustrative; actual items follow Apple's released versions.
- CFD trading carries a high level of risk due to leverage. Read the full terms before participating.
- Contact: support@qubemarkets.com
